# Pamir Moto Adventure

> Motorcycle and 4x4 rental in Dushanbe, Tajikistan. Pamir Highway, Wakhan Valley, CIS journeys, guided rides and supported expeditions. A website request is not a confirmed booking.

English: https://pamirmoto.com/en

Fleet: 12 Honda CRF300L motorcycles (CRF-01 to CRF-12). Prices are on request until a written quotation.
Location: Dushanbe, Tajikistan. Languages: English and Russian.
